label: MP-4(2)
title: Automated Restricted Access

statement.prose: Restrict access to media storage areas and log access attempts and access granted using {{ insert: param, mp-4.2_prm_1 }}.

guidance: Automated mechanisms include keypads, biometric readers, or card readers on the external entries to media storage areas.

params.label: automated mechanisms
guidelines: automated mechanisms to restrict access to media storage areas are defined;

params.label: automated mechanisms
guidelines: automated mechanisms to log access attempts to media storage areas are defined;

params.label: automated mechanisms
guidelines: automated mechanisms to log access granted to media storage areas are defined;
